## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create** in the **Create New Integration** card.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `HotelFinder`.
5. <!-- manual: Set Project Name as AI-Integrations. -->
6. Select **Create Integration**.

## Step 2: Add an AI chat agent

1. In the design view, select **+ Add Artifact**.
2. Select **AI Chat Agent** under **AI Integration**.
3. Set **Name** to `HotelFinderAssistant`.
4. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Configure the agent

1. Select **AI Agent** node.
2. Set **Role** to `HotelFinderAssistant`.
3. <!-- manual: Set Instructions to: -->
4. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Run and test

1. Select **Run** in the toolbar.
2. Select **Chat**.
3. Wait 8 seconds.
4. <!-- manual: Type Show me hotels in Paris to check if it works. -->
